summary: The proof establishes the stated uniform bound for every allowed chain partition, coordinate, positive multiplier, and field. The fixed-bit mixed exploration remains fresh, visits the exceptional block at most once, and yields the claimed forbidden-coordinate census. The predecessor halfspace selection applies at the same height parameters and stays inside each of slices zero and one because its displacements use only the avoiding inverse continuation. The full slice normalizers, both height ranges, the slice-two anchor count and injective source map, and all fourth-power and numerical constants are valid. The final mixture inequality preserves the original support, normalization, sampling law, and ambient halfspaces, and gives the claimed multiplier-independent constant, including the boundary Pi(lambda)=1 and k=8.
